articles.title: Karnataka Tourist Swept Away by Massive Waves at Goa's Baga Beach, Dies Despite Rescue Efforts
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 33-year-old tourist from Karnataka lost his life after being swept away by powerful waves while sitting on rocks at Baga Beach in North Goa, officials said on Wednesday. The deceased has been identified as Sahas Ashpak Masali, a resident of Bijapur district in Karnataka.

body.html:
A 33-year-old tourist from Karnataka lost his life after being swept away by powerful waves while sitting on rocks at Baga Beach in North Goa, officials said on Wednesday.

The deceased has been identified as Sahas Ashpak Masali, a resident of Bijapur district in Karnataka.

According to preliminary information, Masali was sitting on rocks along the shoreline when a series of strong waves, triggered by rough sea conditions, struck the area and swept him into the water. Despite immediate efforts to trace him, he was carried away by strong currents.

Authorities launched a search and rescue operation soon after the incident. After several hours of searching, rescue teams recovered his body from the shoreline.

A video purportedly capturing the incident has since gone viral on social media, highlighting the dangers of venturing onto rocky stretches of the coast during rough weather and high tide conditions.

The footage appears to show a man struggling in turbulent waters near the rocks after being overwhelmed by the waves. With the sea remaining rough and visibility poor, an immediate rescue proved difficult.

Following the tragedy, officials once again urged tourists to stay away from rocks along the coastline and avoid entering the sea during rough weather conditions. Authorities warned that powerful waves can strike without warning, making rocky coastal areas particularly dangerous.

Further details are awaited.

articles.title: Blood Plasma Adulteration Racket Busted: Four Arrested, ₹12 Lakh Worth of Material Seized
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Ahmedabad Rural Special Operations Group (SOG) has busted an alleged blood plasma adulteration racket operating in the Changodar area and arrested four accused, including the alleged mastermind behind the operation.

body.html:
Ahmedabad Rural Special Operations Group (SOG) has busted an alleged blood plasma adulteration racket operating in the Changodar area and arrested four accused, including the alleged mastermind behind the operation.

Police said material worth approximately ₹12.06 lakh was seized during the operation.

According to investigators, the case came to light following specific intelligence inputs received by the police. During the probe, officers allegedly uncovered a scheme in which genuine blood plasma units collected for pharmaceutical companies were replaced with adulterated plasma bags before delivery.

The main accused has been identified as Dineshbhai Umabhai Chaudhary, who reportedly had prior experience in blood plasma collection within the pharmaceutical sector.

Police alleged that Chaudhary used his industry knowledge to carry out the fraud by removing genuine plasma units and replacing them with adulterated ones.

Investigators said the driver and co-driver of the plasma collection vehicle allegedly informed the accused in advance about collection routes and the quantity of plasma being transported. Based on this information, the accused would allegedly prepare the required number of adulterated plasma units.

According to police, before the collected plasma was delivered to pharmaceutical companies, the vehicle was taken to the accused's residence. There, genuine plasma units were allegedly separated and replaced with adulterated units, which were then supplied to the companies.

Following the registration of a case at Changodar Police Station under relevant legal provisions, the investigation was transferred to the Ahmedabad Rural SOG.

During the course of the investigation, police obtained custody of the accused and expanded the probe into Maharashtra, eventually arresting the alleged mastermind of the racket.

Police said they seized 1,140 blood plasma units, a deep freezer, a sealing machine, chemical bottles, empty plasma bags and a Mahindra Bolero pickup vehicle during the operation.

Authorities stated that the total value of the seized material is estimated at around ₹12.06 lakh.

Further investigation is underway to determine the full extent of the alleged racket and identify any additional persons involved.

articles.title: Man Accused of Trying to Run Over Son and Daughter-in-Law With Car After Family Dispute
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing incident captured on CCTV has surfaced from Maharashtra's Amravati, where a man is accused of attempting to kill his son and daughter-in-law by allegedly driving his car at them following a family dispute.

body.html:
A disturbing incident captured on CCTV has surfaced from Maharashtra's Amravati, where a man is accused of attempting to kill his son and daughter-in-law by allegedly driving his car at them following a family dispute.

The incident reportedly took place on Sunday morning and was captured on surveillance cameras installed near a local hotel.

A video of the incident, which has gone viral on social media, allegedly shows the accused speeding his vehicle towards the couple while they were standing outside the hotel.

According to the CCTV footage, the son and daughter-in-law narrowly escaped a direct impact. However, the vehicle crashed into the hotel premises, causing damage to the building and a compound wall.

The footage also purportedly shows the daughter-in-law being struck during the incident. She reportedly suffered serious injuries to her legs and waist and was admitted to a hospital for treatment.

Following the incident, the injured woman lodged a complaint against her father-in-law, accusing him of attempting to kill her and her husband.

Based on the complaint, police have registered a case and initiated an investigation into the matter.

Officials are examining the CCTV footage and other evidence to establish the exact sequence of events and determine the circumstances that led to the alleged attack.

Further details are awaited.

articles.title: Road Rage in Pune: Cab Driver Booked for Allegedly Assaulting PMPML Bus Driver Over Overtaking Disp
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A road rage incident was reported in Pune after a driver of a mobile app-based cab service allegedly assaulted a Pune Mahanagar Parivahan Mahamandal Limited (PMPML) bus driver following a dispute over overtaking at Bopdev Ghat in the Kondhwa area.

body.html:
A road rage incident was reported in Pune after a driver of a mobile app-based cab service allegedly assaulted a Pune Mahanagar Parivahan Mahamandal Limited (PMPML) bus driver following a dispute over overtaking at Bopdev Ghat in the Kondhwa area.

A video of the incident has gone viral on social media, showing a man holding the shirt collar of a bus driver during a heated argument on the roadside.

According to police, the incident occurred at around 6.30 am on June 21 when a PMPML bus travelling towards Saswad allegedly came into contact with a car while overtaking.

The bus driver, identified as Ashok Pandurang Pawar (40), later lodged a complaint with Yevalewadi Police Station.

According to the complaint, the car driver became enraged after the minor collision. The accused allegedly overtook the bus, stopped his vehicle in front of it and confronted Pawar.

Police said the accused allegedly abused the bus driver, dragged him out of the driver's seat and assaulted him before fleeing the scene.

The complainant further alleged that the accused also tore the conductor's uniform during the altercation.

Following the complaint, Yevalewadi Police registered an FIR and launched an investigation into the matter.

Officials said the accused fled towards Saswad after the incident. Police are examining CCTV footage and other evidence to identify and trace him.

The viral video shows the accused holding the bus driver's collar in the middle of the road while arguing over the alleged collision. The person recording the video also captured the registration number of the car, which is visible in the footage.

Police said further investigation is underway and appropriate legal action will be taken based on the findings.

#Pune #RoadRage #PMPML #Kondhwa #BopdevGhat

articles.title: 5 Arrested After Viral Video Allegedly Shows Chicken Cooking, Alcohol Consumption on Boat in Ganga
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Five people have been arrested in Uttar Pradesh's Varanasi after police took action over a purported video showing a group allegedly cooking chicken and consuming alcohol aboard a boat in the River Ganga.

body.html:
Five people have been arrested in Uttar Pradesh's Varanasi after police took action over a purported video showing a group allegedly cooking chicken and consuming alcohol aboard a boat in the River Ganga.

The video, which circulated widely on social media, triggered outrage and prompted authorities to register a case and seize the vessel seen in the footage.

According to police, the alleged gathering took place on a boat near Dashashwamedh Ghat. The viral clip, which runs for more than a minute, appears to show several men seated on the boat at night while food is being prepared and drinks are being consumed onboard.

Police said the individuals seen in the footage were identified and detained after the video surfaced online.

The accused have been identified as Deepak Kumar, Ajay Sahani, Arun Kumar Sahani, Anurag Nishad and Rahul Sahani, all residents linked to the Ramnagar area of Varanasi.

A case has been registered at Dashashwamedh Police Station under relevant provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). Police have also seized the boat allegedly used during the incident.

Speaking on the matter, ACP Dashashwamedh Atul Anjan Tripathi said police acted immediately after the clip gained attention online.

"The video was taken into cognisance as soon as it went viral. The individuals seen in it were identified and arrested. It appears to be an old video, as the people visible in the footage seem to be wearing warm clothes associated with the winter season," the officer said.

He added that the boat involved in the incident had also been seized and further legal proceedings were underway.

Responding to questions regarding ownership of the boat and monitoring of such activities, the ACP said police and special teams have been maintaining surveillance along the riverfront and that incidents of this nature had reduced in recent months.

The officer urged local boat operators and visitors to refrain from activities that could hurt public sentiments, warning that violations would invite strict legal action.

Police also said claims circulating on social media linking the boat to a local political functionary remain under inquiry. Officials noted that the individual mentioned in such claims was not visible in the viral video.

The case follows similar controversies in recent months. In March, police arrested 14 youths after a purported video showed an iftar gathering aboard a boat in the Ganga during Ramzan, leading to allegations that religious sentiments had been hurt. In another incident in May, police initiated action after a video allegedly showed a man consuming beer while bathing in the river.

With another social media-triggered case under investigation, authorities have reiterated that activities on the River Ganga that are perceived as disturbing public order or hurting religious sentiments will attract legal action.

#Varanasi #Ganga #DashashwamedhGhat #UttarPradesh #ViralVideo

articles.title: Three Arrested for Allegedly Attacking Police Team, Damaging Vehicle in Gujarat's Ambaji
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Police have arrested three men accused of attacking police personnel and damaging a police vehicle in Gujarat's Ambaji on Sunday evening. The accused were later taken to the scene of the incident, where police conducted a reconstruction of events as part of the investigation.

body.html:
Police have arrested three men accused of attacking police personnel and damaging a police vehicle in Gujarat's Ambaji on Sunday evening. The accused were later taken to the scene of the incident, where police conducted a reconstruction of events as part of the investigation.

According to the police complaint, the incident began when a group of anti-social elements allegedly got into an altercation with a couple travelling on a motorcycle in Area No. 8. The accused reportedly abused and harassed the couple, prompting a call to the police.

A police team arrived at the spot and attempted to defuse the situation. However, the accused allegedly turned aggressive and attacked the police personnel. They are also accused of pelting stones at the police vehicle and damaging its windows with wooden sticks.

Videos of the incident surfaced on social media shortly afterwards and went viral, drawing widespread attention.

Following the attack, Ambaji Police formed multiple teams to trace the suspects. Two accused were arrested initially, while the third was apprehended later.

On Monday evening, police escorted all three accused to the scene of the incident and recreated the sequence of events as part of the ongoing investigation.

The arrested accused have been identified as Dinesh, Vikabhai and Kalubhai.

Deputy Superintendent of Police V.B. Barad of Danta Division said the dispute began after an argument involving a couple residing in Area No. 8. He stated that the accused later attacked the police vehicle, pelted stones and shattered its windows using wooden sticks.

Police said further investigations are underway to determine whether the accused were involved in any other criminal activities. Additional legal action will be taken based on the findings of the probe.

The swift arrests were welcomed by several local residents, who praised the police for promptly identifying and apprehending the accused.

#Gujarat #Ambaji #PoliceAttack #CrimeNews #PoliceAction

articles.title: Argument Over Closing Train Door Turns Fatal: 22-Year-Old Stabbed to Death in Mumbai Local
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dispute over closing the door of a Mumbai local train during heavy rain turned deadly late Monday night when a 22-year-old passenger was allegedly stabbed to death by a fellow commuter inside a first-class coach, police said.

body.html:
A dispute over closing the door of a Mumbai local train during heavy rain turned deadly late Monday night when a 22-year-old passenger was allegedly stabbed to death by a fellow commuter inside a first-class coach, police said.

The incident took place aboard the Churchgate–Nallasopara Fast Local between Andheri and Borivali stations.

The victim, identified as Mayank Ramesh Lohar, and the accused had boarded the first-class compartment at Andheri and were travelling in the same coach when an argument reportedly broke out over whether the train door should remain open or be shut amid the downpour.

According to the Government Railway Police (GRP), the verbal altercation quickly escalated into violence. The accused allegedly pulled out a knife and stabbed Lohar in the abdomen inside the moving train, leaving him critically injured.

Police said that as the train approached Borivali station at around 11 pm, the accused allegedly jumped off before the train came to a complete halt at Platform No. 6 and fled the scene.

The train arrived at Borivali station at approximately 11.04 pm, following which Railway Protection Force (RPF) personnel, GRP officials and medical teams rushed to the coach.

Lohar was removed from the compartment and taken for emergency medical treatment. Doctors examined him at the station's Emergency Medical Room at around 11.22 pm and declared him dead.

His body was later shifted to Shatabdi Hospital in Kandivali for post-mortem and further legal formalities.

Borivali GRP has registered a case and launched a search operation to trace the accused, whose identity has not yet been established.

Officials said CCTV footage from the station and other evidence were immediately secured and handed over to investigators. Senior Western Railway officials also visited Borivali station and reviewed the response and security arrangements following the incident.

Preliminary investigation suggests the stabbing stemmed from a dispute over closing the train door during heavy rainfall. Police are examining CCTV footage, eyewitness statements and other evidence to establish the exact sequence of events.

Further investigation is underway.

#Mumbai #MumbaiLocal #TrainCrime #Borivali #Andheri

articles.title: Truck Drags Bike for 3 km After Fatal Collision Near Agra Cut, Vehicle Catches Fire
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A man was killed in a horrific road accident near Agra Cut on Sunday night after a truck allegedly hit his motorcycle from behind. The bike became lodged under the truck and was dragged for nearly three kilometres before catching fire, police said.

body.html:
A man was killed in a horrific road accident near Agra Cut on Sunday night after a truck allegedly hit his motorcycle from behind. The bike became lodged under the truck and was dragged for nearly three kilometres before catching fire, police said.

The deceased was identified as Mohammad Intesab, son of Nazir Ahmed and a resident of Bhujpura in the Kotwali area.

According to police, Intesab was travelling on a Splendor motorcycle along the highway via Agra Cut at around 9 pm. As he was turning towards Delhi, a truck allegedly struck his motorcycle from behind near Agra Cut in the Sasni Gate area.

The impact was so severe that Intesab died on the spot. His motorcycle became trapped underneath the truck and was dragged for several kilometres before bursting into flames.

The fire was eventually brought under control near Gonda Bridge in the Roravar area with the help of the truck driver and local residents.

Following the accident, personnel from Madrak and Sasni Gate police stations rushed to the scene. Traffic movement in the area was affected for some time, and police reportedly dealt with jurisdiction-related issues during the initial response.

Sasni Gate Station House Officer Rajveer Parmar said the victim fell at the accident site while the motorcycle remained stuck under the truck and was dragged away.

The body has been sent for post-mortem examination, and a case has been registered against the truck driver. Further investigation is underway.

Family members said Mohammad Intesab belonged to a large family with six brothers and one sister and was the fifth among the siblings.

#Agra #RoadAccident #TruckAccident #BreakingNews #UttarPradesh
